data.name: Aishaah
data.gender_notes: Aishaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aishaah is an Arabic name that means 'alive' or 'well-living'. It is also the name of one of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Aishaah carries the meaning “Alive, Well-Living” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aishaah usually hope their child will grow to embody alive, well-living and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aishaah is a name that symbolizes life, vitality, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Aishaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Alive, Well-Living.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aishaah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عائشأ
in_arabic.meaning: معنى الاسم هو الفتاة الحلوة والجميلة والشقيقة

Aishaah bint Abu Bakr (ra) is revered as a Sahabiyat (female companion) of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was not only his beloved wife, but also an accomplished scholar, poet, and diplomat. The life and teachings of Aishaah have inspired countless generations and continue to shape Islamic and Arabic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aishaah carries immense spiritual significance for Muslims as it represents the living and vibrant nature of Islam. It is a reminder of the active, ongoing nature of faith and the importance of living one's life in submission to Allah. Aishaah, as a wife, scholar, and community leader, serves as a model of how to make the most of this life, seeking knowledge, cultivating good character, and serving others. Through her example, Muslims are inspired to embody the best qualities of humanity and strive for spiritual growth and fulfillment.
